EVT-0141.agent_script_text: Namaskar, main aapko yeh reminder dene ke liye call kar raha hoon ki aapka invoice amount ₹1,98,502 abhi tak pending hai aur yeh 68 days overdue ho chuka hai. Hum aapse anurodh karte hain ki aap kripya is payment ko jaldi se jaldi clear karein. Ismein aapka hi sahyog rahega, dhanyawad.
EVT-0141.customer_response_text: Achha theek hai, itna late kaise ho gaya mujhe check karna padega. Main aaj hi accounts team se baat karke payment clear karvata hoon.
